summary: Iteration 50 — Superadmin Affiliate Payouts console: full backend regression suite (14 tests, all passing) plus end-to-end UI validation of the mark-paid modal. All 4 new endpoints (overview, per-referrer, mark-paid, reverse, history) verified for shape, auth gates, seed→mark-paid state transition, cherry-pick semantics, idempotency, and reverse-payout with $unset + reversal_log push. Frontend: modal opens, lines load, deselection updates total-to-pay ($84 → $77), submit closes modal, and History pane renders the new batch with external_ref + note.
critical_code_review_comments: SuperadminDash.jsx is 1089 lines with multiple large embedded components (AffiliatePayoutsCard + MarkPaidModal). Consider splitting into separate files under /components/superadmin/ for maintainability once the file crosses 700 lines.
admin.py is 1586 lines and continues to grow with every iteration. Splitting affiliate/payout endpoints into a dedicated router (routes/admin_affiliate.py) would help readability.

mark-paid endpoint creates a batch row even when marked=0 could be argued either way; current code short-circuits (returns early) when nothing matches so no zero-amount batch row is created — this is the desired behavior and matches idempotency test expectations.

reverse_payout endpoint does not delete or reduce the corresponding entry in referral_payout_batches; the batch row still shows the original amount_cents. Consider whether history batches should also be flagged/adjusted when a reversal happens (currently only the earning row is corrected). Non-blocking.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests self-seed TEST_earn_* rows and clean them up in finally blocks. UI test used a one-shot seeder (3 accrued rows on pro@axiom.ai referrer, share_cents=[700,1500,2000]). All TEST_-prefixed rows and any WISE-UI-TEST batches have been cleaned via /app/scripts/cleanup_iter50_test_data.py.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter50_payout_console.py uses parallel-safe patterns: each test seeds its own rows with unique TEST_earn_ ids and cleans up in finally. Do NOT assert exact aggregate totals under xdist parallelism — use >= comparisons or scope assertions to the specific seeded ids. UI checkboxes have data-testid on the <input> element directly (mark-paid-line-{id}), so click the testid rather than a nested selector.
